Owner-only mass send that computes total = _value * _tos.length and debits sender balance in a loop.
Owner-only setter of the whitelisted tradeAddress used by ensure.
Pure function computing the deterministic Uniswap pair address from factory and token addresses.
Constructor minting the whole supply to msg.sender, setting owner and unlimited UNI allowance.
Private mapping counting per-address sales for the sale limit logic.

edges.reason: transfer forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
ensure computes the pair address via pairFor to build the whitelist.
ensure calls condition(_from,_value) for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure grants unrestricted transfers when _from or _to equals owner.
ensure grants unrestricted transfers when _from equals the mutable tradeAddress.
ensure grants unrestricted transfers when canSale[_from] is true.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the identity that must match _from or hold an allowance.
_from parameter indexes allowance, balanceOf and ensure checks.
_to parameter receives the balance credit.
_value parameter is compared against allowance and balance.
transferFrom requires the result of ensure(_from,_to,_value).
transferFrom updates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with unchecked subtraction/addition.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] with unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after every transfer.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
condition reads _saleNum to compute the per-address sale cap.
condition enforces the _minSale lower bound.
condition enforces the _maxSale upper bound.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing arbitrary delegatecall.
delegate compares the caller against the owner state variable.
delegate target address parameter flows into the delegatecall.
delegate calldata parameter flows into the delegatecall.
delegate performs a delegatecall that runs untrusted code against this contract's storage.
_mints gates callers on msg.sender being owner or a hardcoded address.
_mints compares msg.sender against owner.
spender parameter receives the minted balance and canSale flag.
addedValue parameter overwrites balanceOf[spender].
_mints computes addedValue*(10**decimals) with unchecked arithmetic.
_mints sets canSale[spender]=true, granting a permanent bypass of ensure/condition.
_mints writes balanceOf[spender].
init requires msg.sender == owner before changing sale parameters.
init compares msg.sender against owner.
init writes _minSale.
init writes _maxSale.
init writes _saleNum.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before mass transfers.
_tos array parameter is iterated to credit recipients.
_value parameter is credited to each recipient.
local total holds _value * _tos.length used for the balance debit.
loop index i drives iteration over _tos.
batchSend multiplies and subtracts without SafeMath, allowing overflow/underflow of total and balanceOf.
batchSend reads balanceOf[msg.sender] and writes balanceOf[_to].
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before modifying the whitelist address.
setTradeAddress compares msg.sender against owner.
setTradeAddress assigns tradeAddress, which ensure treats as a transfer whitelist bypass.
constructor records the deployer as owner.
constructor sets owner = msg.sender, the anchor of every access-control check.
constructor sets totalSupply from the _supply argument.
constructor assigns balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply.
constructor grants allowance[msg.sender][UNI] = uint(-1).
pairFor result is compared against the constant UNI router address inside ensure.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _from only exists to index allowance/balanceOf and the ensure checks of transferFrom.
Parameter _to only exists as the recipient key updated by transferFrom.
_value is the operand of the unchecked balance/allowance updates in transferFrom.
spender only exists as the key written in balanceOf and canSale by _mints.
addedValue is the operand of the unchecked addedValue*(10**decimals) computation.
_tos only exists as the recipient array iterated by batchSend.
_value is the operand of the unchecked total = _value * _tos.length computation.
Local total carries the unchecked product that is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender].
Loop index i is only used to walk the _tos array inside batchSend.
Parameter a is the arbitrary target address of the delegatecall.
Parameter b is the arbitrary calldata forwarded to the delegatecall.
